entities.summary: Antigonid, a notable figure in the history of Greece, associated with Alexander the Great and the Hellenistic Period (323 BCE–146 BCE). Preceded by Hellenistic Successor Kingdoms and Death of Alexander the Great in Babylon. Their legacy influenced Roman Conquest and Province of Achaea.
